contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---]LENTI ANVS PF AVG ; R/ GLORIA RO [MANORVM]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Emperor right issue, probably Arles mint, Reece period 19. Chipped; robustly cleaned by the finder. Obverse description: Helmeted bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]LENTI ANVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive; the emperor stands and his right arm loops over to grasp captive. O left field and FI right field. Reverse inscription: GLORIA RO [MANORVM]. In exergue: possibly CON. Diameter: 19.6mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: 12
